not_implemented: --{command} is not implemented yet; see ROADMAP.md
run_as_user: manage-git installs into a user's own directories; run it as that user, not as root
unsupported_system: {system} is not a platform this manager supports
unsupported_arch: conda-forge publishes no {system} build this manager maps for {machine}; known: {known}
python_too_old: manage-git needs Python 3.14 or later to read conda packages; this is Python {found}
conda_invalid: {path}: not a conda package this manager understands: {reason}
size_mismatch: {path}: size is {found} bytes, the lock expects {expected}
check_title: Baseline {baseline}: git {minimum} or later, with the required configuration
check_ready: Ready: the first git on PATH meets the baseline
check_not_ready: Not ready: the first git on PATH does not meet the baseline
check_no_git: No git found on PATH or among managed versions
problem_version_too_old: version {found} is older than the baseline minimum {minimum}
problem_config_missing: {key} is not set; the baseline needs {expected}
problem_system_config_missing: its system configuration {path} is missing; reinstall this version
config_key_invalid: {key} is not a configuration key the manager can write
config_value_invalid: {value} cannot be written to a git configuration file
launcher_path_invalid: {path} cannot be written into a launcher safely
